title: Genesys Hack Exposes Customer Data From Internal Systems
description: Genesys experienced a cyberattack involving unauthorized access to internal business systems, including a learning management system and a customer relationship management environment. The Genesys Cloud, Genesys Engage, and Genesys Engage Cloud platforms were not compromised, and customer and partner data within those platforms remain secure. The attackers accessed and likely downloaded business and account information used to manage customer relationships, including names, phone numbers, business emails, job titles, and company information. Genesys contained the incident by suspending the LMS platform and confirmed full containment by October 23, 2026. The investigation is ongoing, and customers are cautioned to watch for phishing attempts impersonating Genesys.
